commands.summary: Add a via padstack to the central library: plated hole, round pads, mask opening or tented.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --drill
flags.summary: The finished hole diameter.

flags.name: --pad
flags.summary: The pad diameter on every conductor layer; wider than the hole.

flags.name: --mask
flags.summary: The soldermask opening's diameter; without it the via is tented, covered by soldermask or coverlay.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The padstack's name; VIA_D<drill>_P<pad> in mm by default, such as VIA_D0.2_P0.4.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Pour a solid or hatched plane shape for one net on one layer.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net, such as GND.

flags.name: --layer
flags.summary: The conductor layer number, 1 at the top.

flags.name: --margin
flags.summary: The distance from a rectangular board outline; 1 mm by default. On any other outline the plane follows the route border.

flags.name: --hatch
flags.summary: solid (the default), orthogonal or diagonal: a hatched plane, common on flex, is a grid of lines.

flags.name: --hatch-width
flags.summary: A hatched plane's line width.

flags.name: --hatch-distance
flags.summary: A hatched plane's distance from line to line, larger than the width.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Route the open nets with the autorouter: all, or the nets and net classes named.

flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --layers
flags.summary: The conductor layers to route on, such as 1,4; all by default.

flags.name: --nets
flags.summary: Route only these nets, such as SS_TX1_P,SS_TX1_N.

flags.name: --net-classes
flags.summary: Route only the nets of these net classes, such as USB_SS.

flags.name: --passes
flags.summary: The autorouter passes in order, each with its effort 1 to 5, such as fanout:1,route:1-5,smooth; route:1-5,viamin:1-3,smooth:1-3 by default. Passes: fanout, route, novia, viamin, smooth, spread, expand, removehangers.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.
